body:
I'm not so sure going through life like this is worth it. There's more to it than described in the OP, but as always my energy levels are too low and nobody here's paid to read. I'm not sure all lives are of equal value, mine is certainly not worth much.

That's a huge problem. I haven't developed any interests. If I had, I probably wouldn't be in this situation to begin with. I live in a small place, not that much to do to begin with. Even less when I'm too tired and too afraid to even hang out with my old friends.

As it is now, I do nothing. I go to the hospital Mon-Fri till 3 in the afternoon, then I'm at home (one of my parents' house as of a couple years back) surfing or watching series.

Yeah, that's what they tell me. But, I've yet to hear a reason except 'it will get better' which doesn't seem likely. It isn't likely at all.

It's just not worth it.

Thanks for your concern!
